name: AG-NeRF
definition: An end-to-end framework for novel view synthesis of large-scale outdoor scenes that handles varying camera altitudes (from drone-level to satellite-level) without requiring a priori camera height or scene scope, reducing training cost compared to multi-stage methods like BungeeNeRF.
summary: AG-NeRF is an end-to-end framework for novel view synthesis of large-scale outdoor scenes that uses attention-based feature fusion to handle varying camera altitudes without requiring a priori camera height knowledge.
